% Pattern: number/counter. \\theorem in a table is a line break and the word
% theorem, not the command \theorem, so it does not step the counter and the
% lemma after it is 1.2. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\begin{tabular}{l}
the main\\theorem
\end{tabular}

\begin{lemma} Every point is closed. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
